title: Поговори со сверстником о привычках
description: Задавай вопросы сверстнику из другой страны о его привычках и образе жизни (14 лет)

sections.name: Lifestyle and habits
questions: What is your daily routine like on a school day?
What time do you usually get up and go to bed?
How do you usually go to school – by bus, by car or on foot?
What do you usually do after school?
How often do you do sports or exercise?
Do you prefer staying at home or going out with friends in your free time?
Do you spend a lot of time online or on social media?
Do you think you lead a healthy lifestyle? Why or why not?
What kind of food do you usually eat – healthy food or fast food?
How often do you eat fast food or drink fizzy drinks?
Do you play any sports or go to a sports centre?
What habits do teenagers in your country usually have?
Are there any bad habits that you can't stand?
What do teenagers in your country usually do at the weekend?
